caveats: Listing is not evidence of Rubaya material. Most reports say a smelter may be in the supply chain, usually from company-level supplier replies. No filing here says a company received Rubaya material.
Time periods may not match. GW covers 2023 to Sep 2025; links are RY2024 and RY2025; M23 took Rubaya around end April 2024. Taniobis says it stopped at end 2023 and Ulba in May 2024.

Rubaya claims against OTIC, Tanbre, Jinxin and Ulba are allegations (documented, Global Witness), not designations. OTIC, Tanbre, Jinxin and Ulba denied them. Taniobis, not linked to Rubaya by GW, says it stopped DRC and Rwanda sourcing at end 2023. Store all five in responses_to_claims; only Ulba and Taniobis were in the brief. RMI disputed GW trade-data timing (warehousing lag).
Links are company self-disclosures on EDGAR; the tier scheme has no exact fit. Sayari rows are inferred. Do not present either as an origin finding (rule 10).
Conformant is not clean. GW reports all eight were found compliant while linking some to conflict coltan. RMAP audits due diligence systems.

China freeze: MOFCOM listed the RBA from 5 Aug 2026 (via secondary source; order not read). On 17 Aug 2026 RMI extended China assessments until further notice and paused new ones. Six of eight are affected. Show their status as frozen.

RMI facility rows and last-assessment dates are a data gap. The list needs an I AGREE click on terms that restrict redistribution; this was not accepted on the user's behalf. rmi_date is null for all eight. A person can open it and decide whether the terms allow publishing those dates.

East Rise lots: Sayari shows East Rise to Ulba on 2024-09-06 (ARE to KAZ, 99.9% tantalum ingots, lots GLK-BOX1 to 12) and Ulba to East Rise on 2024-09-30 (KAZ to HKG, ingots made from those lots). Our analysis suggests tolling or re-melting. This is after the May 2024 stop Ulba described, but it is ingot not ore, and the provenance is unknown. Not a contradiction on this evidence; worth asking Ulba.

Filings were not read cover to cover. A parser pulled rows, status columns, list intros and footnotes from all 96 exhibits. List intros were reviewed for every RY2025 filing, and each wording paraphrase was pattern-checked against the filing for each year. RY2024 list intros were not all reviewed separately.
Roster capped at 40 SEC brands. Parsed but left out: HEICO, Mercury Systems, Polestar, Arista, KLA, GlobalFoundries, UMC, ASE, Seagate, Western Digital.

18 large filers checked name none of the eight in the filing document searched: Apple, Tesla, Ford, GM, Boeing, Dell, HP Inc, Cisco, Alphabet, Meta, IBM, Garmin, Lockheed, RTX, GE Aerospace, Northrop, Broadcom, Stellantis. General Dynamics returned no tantalum hit. Absence means no list in the filing, not no exposure. Samsung, Panasonic, Kyocera and Vodafone are not in this EDGAR set.

Honeywell lists 6 of 8 in RY2024 and 4 in RY2025 because its annex is limited to smelters potentially sourcing from Covered Countries. Qualcomm lists 6 of 8 in RY2024 and 8 in RY2025. Caterpillar omits King Xing. These are real list differences, checked against the parser fix.
Corning column values come from Corning, not RMI directly: covered-country Yes for seven of eight in both years; King Xing No in both. Philips Yes/No columns were not decoded and are not recorded.

Sayari gaps: only first 100 of 542 Ulba rows and 100 of 217 Ximei rows read; 58 of 258 Taniobis rows unread. Rows repeat and are not consignments. Jinxin, Zhongao and King Xing show inbound rows only, so no buyers recorded. No smelter row found to KEMET or Vishay; KEMET rows seen were intra-company. Vishay returned zero under HS 810320, which may be a name or coverage issue.

Unconfirmed lead, not recorded as a link: Ningxia Non Ferrous Metals Import & Export (Q_RbUossNqfXWTLy53ChzA) shipped 9 rows of HS 810320 to Panasonic Industrial Components Indonesia in June 2026. Same province as OTIC; no identifier ties them.

Sayari rows and brand IDs were not fully resolved: buyer IDs are as returned in trade rows, with same-entity checks limited to names, addresses and countries. sayari_entity_id is null for SEC brands. Rule 7 review is still needed before linking.
